findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "agent-services" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: action_lock, check_url, scan_content, extract_structured, preflight_action · Private data: agent_permission_vault, agent_outcome_receipt, invoice_preflight_quote, check_url, scan_content, simulate_transaction, check_wallet, analyze_whale_activity, preflight_action, token_security_audit · Public sink: action_lock, agent_spend_governor, agent_permission_vault, agent_outcome_receipt, invoice_preflight_quote, mcp_server_inspect, check_url, scan_content, simulate_transaction, check_wallet, check_package, route_tool, get_live_quote, extract_structured, check_change, verify_claim, analyze_whale_activity, scan_arbitrage, backtest_strategy, preflight_action, token_security_audit, invoice_preflight, invoice_preflight_10_pages, invoice_preflight_50_pages · Destructive: backtest_strategy.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: action_lock, check_url, scan_content, extract_structured, preflight_action · Private data: agent_permission_vault, agent_outcome_receipt, invoice_preflight_quote, check_url, scan_content, simulate_transaction, check_wallet, analyze_whale_activity, preflight_action, token_security_audit · Public sink: action_lock, agent_spend_governor, agent_permission_vault, agent_outcome_receipt, invoice_preflight_quote, mcp_server_inspect, check_url, scan_content, simulate_transaction, check_wallet, check_package, route_tool, get_live_quote, extract_structured, check_change, verify_claim, analyze_whale_activity, scan_arbitrage, backtest_strategy, preflight_action, token_security_audit, invoice_preflight, invoice_preflight_10_pages, invoice_preflight_50_pages · Destructive: backtest_strategy

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
